label: DESCRIPTIVE. The MCsquare endpoints are the same-host Portable runs at 2f9dab40: they were read before this design was fixed, and they ran on other hosts than TOPAS. No margin, no pass or fail, no attribution of cause. Intervals are pointwise. The three Portable arms share one TOPAS arm, so their rows are not independent.

dataset_fingerprint.definition: sha256 of the sorted '<sha256>  <path relative to root>' lines of every file read
